opportunities.point: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.

opportunities.point: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation, and packaging industries.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries." (annual report)

opportunities.point: The plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.

(annual report)

opportunities.point: Production of calcined petroleum coke for the fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 metric tonnes.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24." (annual report)

opportunities.point: The completion of projects currently under construction is expected within FY 2026-27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage." (annual report) [FY27]

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 26 -> 72 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 12 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 4 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Receivables are stretching year on year.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025 primarily due to volatility and elevation in raw material prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Volatility in Raw Material Prices The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)

threats.point: Heavy reliance on imports, especially low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other Europe and Asian countries, affects cost and availability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)

threats.point: Demand is tied to the aluminium, steel, and battery sectors, which are each sensitive to economic cycles.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Demand tied to aluminium, steel, and battery sectors—each sensitive to economic cycles." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.
